mcp.enableDesc: Let AI assistants (e.g. Claude Desktop) read your notebooks and notes over a local, token-protected connection. Off by default.
mcp.statusMismatchWarning: MCP is enabled in settings, but the server did not start correctly this session. AI clients cannot connect until this is fixed.
mcp.notListeningWarning: MCP is enabled, but port {{port}} was already in use when NoteBerg started, so the server is not running. Close whatever is using that port (another NoteBerg window, for example) and restart NoteBerg.
mcp.tokensDesc: Each MCP client (e.g. Claude Desktop, Cursor) should get its own named token, so you can tell them apart in the access log and revoke one without affecting the others.
mcp.revokeConfirmMsg: This immediately disables MCP access for any client using this token. You can generate a new token at any time.
mcp.tokenNamePromptMsg: Give this token a name so you can recognize which client it belongs to (e.g. "Claude Desktop", "Work laptop").
mcp.tokenShownOnceWarningCopied: This token is shown only once and has been copied to your clipboard. Paste it into your MCP client's configuration now — it cannot be viewed again after closing this dialog.
mcp.tokenShownOnceWarning: This token is shown only once and could not be copied automatically. Copy it now — it cannot be viewed again after closing this dialog.
mcp.auditLogEnableDesc: Keep a durable record of every request made through the MCP connection (which tool, when, success/failure) — separate from the general debug logs below, and not affected by clearing them.
mcp.clearAuditLogConfirmMsg: This permanently deletes the recorded history of MCP tool calls. This cannot be undone.

dangerZone.resetPasswordDesc: Clear master password and encryption keys. You'll need to set a new password.
dangerZone.resetPasswordConfirmMsg:
⚠️ This will clear your master password and encryption keys.

After reset, you'll need to set a new master password to use encryption.

Note: Encrypted notes will remain encrypted and cannot be decrypted without the original password.
dangerZone.resetPasswordSuccessMsg: ✓ Master password has been cleared. You can now set a new password by enabling encryption.
dangerZone.purgeLocalDesc: Clears ALL local notebooks and notes from this device.
dangerZone.purgeConfirmMsg:
⚠️ DANGER: This will DELETE ALL local notebooks and notes from this device!

This includes:
  • All notebooks and notes
  • All deleted items (recycle bin)
  • Local sync history
This action cannot be undone. Are you absolutely sure you want to continue?
dangerZone.purgeSuccessStatus: ✓ Local data purged successfully! Click "Sync Now" to download from server.
dangerZone.purgeSuccessMsgConnected:
Local data purged successfully!

Next steps:
  1. Click 'Sync Now' to download all data from Nextcloud
  2. Wait for sync to complete
  3. Your notes will be restored from the server
dangerZone.warningConnected: ⚠️ This action will delete all local data including notebooks, notes, and sync history. If you are connected to Nextcloud, you can restore your data by syncing again. Unsynced changes will be permanently lost.
dangerZone.warningDisconnected: ⚠️ This action will delete all local data including notebooks, notes, and sync history. This action is permanent and cannot be undone.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.body: Your changes are saved automatically as you work — there's no save button. When you close a note, it also syncs to Nextcloud if you've set up sync.

pan.title: Pan & zoom
pan.body: Drag with touch to pan and pinch to zoom. If you start writing with a stylus, the mode switches to Draw automatically while finger touch stays on panning.

text.title: Text
text.body: Type formatted text anywhere on the page — headings, formatting, lists, tables, and links are supported. Select text and use the ✓ button to turn it into a checkable task.

draw.title: Draw
draw.body: Tap Draw to pick a pen or highlighter and change color or width. Handwriting recognition is only available on Windows.

eraser.title: Eraser
eraser.body: Erase whole strokes, or switch to the part eraser to rub out only the piece you touch. You can also limit erasing to highlighters.

lasso.title: Lasso select
lasso.body: Circle handwriting and highlighter with the lasso to select, then drag to move or resize. Mark as Task is also available from the ⋮ menu of the selection.

options.title: More options
options.body: Open the note menu for export, page settings, and more.

insert.title: Insert
insert.body: Add images, a PDF, or a camera photo here.

firstImage.title: Working with images
firstImage.body: Select an image by long-pressing it (finger/mouse) or via its ⋮ menu → Select, then drag to move or resize. More options are in the ⋮ menu.

markAsTask.title: Tasks
markAsTask.body: The text you marked is now a checkable task. Tick it off here or from your task list.
